title: UK labour market overview — earnings, unemployment and vacancies (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET), the NEXT quarter-aligned release after 2027-02-16, carrying Jan–Mar 2027 = 2027 Q1 exactly
source: EST: gov.uk/government/statistics/announcements/uk-labour-market-may-2027, fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200) — the statutory pre-announcement register reads 'Release date: 18 May 2027 7:00am (confirmed)', producer Office for National Statistics, 'Published: 30 June 2026', 'Last updated: 30 June 2026', with no amendment note (unlike the 2027-02-16 entry, whose own register line records 'Reason for change: Input error corrected'). Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics — the same gap all six 2026-27 siblings were filed under. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-labour-market-2027-02-16, 2026-09-10
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-labour-market-2027-02-16 LANE, 2026-09-10. WHY IT EARNS A SLOT: it is the next instance of the proposing lane's own headline mechanism, so filing it means no later lane has to re-derive which release that is. By the window rule this chain has now reconfirmed five times firsthand (a release in month M carries the three months M-4 to M-2 for headline AWE/LFS; vacancies end one month before; the payrolled-employees flash is the month before), that equals a CALENDAR QUARTER only for the February, May, August and November releases. So this release carries JAN-MAR 2027 average weekly earnings and Labour Force Survey estimates = 2027 Q1 exactly, FEB-APR 2027 vacancies, and an APRIL 2027 payroll flash — and it is the first quarter-aligned release after the proposing print's own Oct-Dec 2026 = 2026 Q4. That matters because a quarter-aligned window is the only kind an MPR quarterly private-AWE diamond maps onto 1:1 with no blending, which is the mechanism registered as FT-uk-labour-market-2027-02-16-2 and FT-uk-labour-market-2027-02-16-3. TWO FURTHER PROPERTIES A LATER LANE WOULD OTHERWISE RE-DERIVE. (1) Its APRIL 2027 payroll flash is the first monthly payroll cell to fall in the tax year beginning April 2027, which is where the 11-17 lane's April-lag precedent says a Budget response would first plausibly be measurable (Autumn Budget 2024-10-30 raised secondary Class 1 NICs 13.8% to 15% effective April 2025); its Jan-Mar AWE window contains NO April month, so the AWE side does not yet carry it. (2) It sits D+19 AFTER the boe-decision-2027-04-29 April Monetary Policy Report round (canonical on this calendar, medium, dated from the Bank's own upcoming-MPC-dates page) and D-30 before the 2027-06-17 round, i.e. the same post-round settlement geometry as the proposing print rather than the last-read-before shape five of the six siblings had. TIERED LOW on the same argued grounds as every sibling: symbols [], this repo tracks no UK-listed symbol, no house playbook is rates- or sterling-keyed, and the measured cable reaction to the 2026-08-18 release was ~0.1% on a two-sided beat. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
